analysis.title: October 2026: First Look on Hedge Fund Performance and Positioning
key_insights: Fundamental L/S hedge funds returned an estimated -3.5% and Systematic L/S -3.6% in October. This is the first time since GS records began in 2016 that both cohorts fell by 3% or more in the same month.
Global equities saw the largest dollar net selling since March. Short sales and long sales were equal in size.
Overall book net leverage fell at the fastest pace since March. Gross leverage rose, driven by mark-to-market.
Fundamental L/S net leverage declined, led by reductions from Asia L/S funds.
Every region except DM Asia was net sold in October. EM Asia and North America led the selling.
In US sectors, hedge funds rotated out of TMT and Cyclicals and into Defensives in October.

sector_views.rationale: Hedge funds rotated out of TMT in October, per GS Prime positioning data.
Hedge funds reduced Cyclicals exposure in October.
Hedge funds rotated into Defensives in October.

risk_factors: Simultaneous losses of more than 3% in both fundamental and systematic L/S cohorts point to crowded or correlated positioning.
